metadata.title: Ronaq Store — Pakistan's Mobile & Electronics Store Directory
metadata.description: Find local mobile and electronics shops in Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad and all cities of Pakistan. View stock, phones, chargers, and accessories.
metadata.homeDescription: Browse smartphone shops across Pakistan. Check live stock, PTA status, chargers and accessories — then order on WhatsApp.

faq.a1: Ronaq Store is a directory of local mobile and electronics shops across Pakistan where you can browse stock and contact shops on WhatsApp.
faq.a2: Yes. Only shops that pass review and keep their store online appear in the public directory.
faq.q3: How do I buy a product?
faq.a3: Open a shop or product page, then use Order via WhatsApp to message the shop directly about price and availability.
